overview.headline: Four meaningful wins, from faster code to clearer decisions.
overview.summary: The day moved two product surfaces forward, removed a recurring test failure, and turned a fuzzy API migration into a decision-ready plan. Most of the value came from shipping and verification, not just activity.

items.title: Shipped a faster activity dashboard
items.summary: Reduced the slowest dashboard path and put a regression check around the improvement.
details: Replaced three sequential requests with one batched query.
Cut the representative cold-load sample from 2.4s to 1.1s.
Added a performance test covering the high-volume account case.

items.title: Fixed the flaky checkout test
items.summary: Removed a timing race that had made the checkout suite unreliable in CI.
details: Waited on the observable payment state instead of a fixed timeout.
Ran the focused scenario 50 times without a failure.
Documented why the previous selector could resolve too early.

items.title: Turned the API migration into a concrete plan
items.summary: Mapped the migration sequence, compatibility boundary, and rollback path for review.
details: Split the work into schema, dual-read, cutover, and cleanup phases.
Identified two clients that still depend on the legacy response shape.
Added measurable exit criteria for every phase.

items.title: Closed the main accessibility gaps in settings
items.summary: Improved keyboard and screen-reader behavior across the account settings flow.
details: Restored visible focus states for every interactive control.
Connected validation messages with their corresponding inputs.
Verified the full flow with keyboard-only navigation.

inProgress.title: Investigating duplicate webhook delivery
inProgress.summary: Reproduced the issue locally and narrowed it to retry handling; no production fix has shipped yet.

caveats: This demonstration uses fictional projects, measurements, and outcomes.
Only completed turns inside the requested window count toward the four wins.
